mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.original_url, a.cover_image, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.create_time, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND a.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.title, CAST(a.id AS CHAR) AS slug, a.summary AS excerpt, a.cover, a.cover_image, a.create_time AS created_at, c.name AS category, a.quantity AS views, GREATEST( 1, CEIL(CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.content_md, ''), NULLIF(a.content, ''), a.summary, '')) / 450) ) AS reading_time FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 1
AND a.id in (SELECT article_id FROM sys_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND a.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.content_md, a.content, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.read_type, a.create_time, a.is_original, a.original_url, a.ai_describe, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname, u.avatar, IFNULL(sc.comment_num, 0) AS commentNum, IFNULL(sal.like_num, 0) AS likeNum FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT article_id, COUNT(1) AS comment_num FROM sys_comment GROUP BY article_id ) sc ON sc.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT article_id, COUNT(1) AS like_num FROM sys_article_like GROUP BY article_id ) sal ON sal.article_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) AS YEAR FROM sys_article WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY YEAR order by YEAR desc
select id,title,create_time from sys_article where status = 1 and DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y' ) = #{year} order by create_time desc
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `date`, COUNT( id ) AS count FROM sys_article WHERE status = 1 AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) group by `date` order by `date` asc
SELECT COUNT( id ) > 0 AS isLike FROM sys_article_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT( a.id ) AS value FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.cover_image, a.content_md, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.create_time FROM sys_article a left join sys_article_like sal on a.id = sal.article_id WHERE sal.user_id = #{userId} order by a.is_stick desc, a.create_time desc
